name: cmmc-level2-assessment-suite
known_facts: CMMC Level 2 requires 100% of 110 NIST SP 800-171 practices to be MET
SPRS is the Supplier Performance Risk System for CMMC scores
DFARS 252.204-7012 requires safeguarding of covered defense information
POAMs require interim controls during remediation
CUI assets must be segregated or entire environment is in scope
FedRAMP Moderate authorization required for cloud services handling CUI
Phishing-resistant MFA required for privileged users

input.cui_types: Controlled Technical Information, Export Controlled Technology
input.enclave_architecture: hybrid (on-premise PLM, cloud ERP with FedRAMP)
